unit.title: Fractions, Decimals & Rational Numbers
unit.essential_question: How do equivalent forms of rational numbers help us compare, calculate, and choose efficient strategies?
big_ideas: Fractions, decimals, and percentages can be equivalent representations of one rational value.
Equivalent fractions preserve value while changing the named unit parts.
Rational-number operations depend on compatible units, scaling, and inverse relationships.
Estimation and benchmarks protect calculations from unreasonable results.
Context, units, and required precision determine the most useful representation.
unit.architecture: Open-age integrated Pre-Algebra learning: instruction + reasoning + practice + application + tools + reflection + mastery
unit.readiness_note: Unit 03 follows the readiness/transition work in Units 01–02. Continue by demonstrated mastery rather than age or grade label.

lessons.title: Rational Numbers & Fraction Meaning
objectives: Interpret fractions as division, measurement, and points on a number line.
Convert between improper fractions and mixed numbers.
Identify rational numbers in fraction and decimal form.
Locate positive and negative fractions relative to integers.

lessons.title: Equivalent Fractions, Simplifying & Benchmarks
objectives: Generate and explain equivalent fractions.
Simplify fractions using common factors and the greatest common factor.
Use benchmark fractions to estimate size.
Recognize multiplication by a form of 1 as the basis of equivalence.

lessons.title: Comparing & Ordering Fractions and Decimals
objectives: Compare fractions using benchmarks, common denominators, or decimal forms.
Order positive and negative rational numbers.
Use cross products as a comparison method and explain why it works.
Choose a comparison strategy suited to the numbers.

lessons.title: Adding & Subtracting Rational Numbers
objectives: Add and subtract fractions with like and unlike denominators.
Operate with positive and negative rational numbers.
Use common denominators while preserving value.
Estimate sums and differences before calculating exactly.

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions & Mixed Numbers
objectives: Interpret fraction multiplication as scaling and part of a part.
Multiply positive and negative fractions.
Convert mixed numbers before multiplying.
Simplify factors before or after multiplication.

lessons.title: Dividing Fractions & Complex Fractions
objectives: Interpret fraction division as measurement or partition.
Divide by multiplying by the reciprocal.
Simplify complex fractions.
Identify why division by zero is undefined.

lessons.title: Decimal Operations, Terminating & Repeating Decimals
objectives: Operate with decimals using place-value reasoning.
Convert fractions to terminating or repeating decimals.
Distinguish terminating and repeating decimal representations.
Round results to a stated precision when appropriate.

lessons.title: Conversions, Estimation & Multi-Step Rational Problems
objectives: Convert among fractions, decimals, and percentages.
Estimate rational-number results before calculating.
Solve multi-step contextual problems with units.
Choose exact or approximate forms appropriate to a purpose.

practice.title: Foundation Practice
practice.description: Scaffolded fraction models, conversion support, hints, and smaller steps.

practice.title: Core Practice
practice.description: Complete unit-level practice across rational-number representations and operations.

practice.title: Extended Practice
practice.description: Proof, error analysis, repeating decimals, and unfamiliar multi-step models.
